rules.rationale: Direct self-harm or suicide wording should route to crisis support before search.

match: I am planning to end my life.
I'm not suicidal, but I don't trust myself tonight.
controls: I am not suicidal and need a therapist for grief.
The movie is about suicide prevention.
I teach a unit on self-harm prevention.

rules.pattern: \b(?:do not|don't|dont|cannot|can't|can not) (?:feel|stay|keep myself|keep me) safe\b|\bnot safe with myself\b|\bdo not trust myself tonight\b|\bdon't trust myself tonight\b
rules.rationale: Inability to stay safe is an active safety signal even without explicit method language.

match: I have pills and do not feel safe.
I do not feel safe with myself.
controls: I am safe tonight and looking for depression therapy.
Need help for burnout, no safety concern.
Looking for a safe therapist office near Denver.

rules.pattern: \b(?:do not|don't|dont) see (?:the )?point (?:anymore|of (?:living|being alive|going on))\b|\b(?:everyone|everybody|my family|the world|people) (?:would|will|'d) be better off without me\b|\bit would be better if i (?:was|were) gone\b|\b(?:do not|don't|dont) want to (?:be alive|wake up)\b|\bwant to disappear(?: and not wake up)?\b|\bnot make it through tonight\b|\balive tomorrow\b|\bdo something irreversible\b|\bthinking about ending (?:my|their|his|her) life\b
rules.rationale: Indirect hopelessness and goodbye-style phrasing can indicate active self-harm risk.

match: I do not see the point anymore.
Everyone would be better off without me.
I want to disappear and not wake up.
I cannot promise I will be alive tomorrow.
controls: Last year I had thoughts about not waking up, but not now.
